name: v264_guidance_rank_clarity_annual
hypothesis: Broad management guidance that tightens in rank space and improves over time may capture planning visibility without raw unit subtraction across heterogeneous guidance items.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.320 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_maxguidance)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_minguidance))), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_estimate)), 63), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_previosestimate))), 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_surface_accel, 126), industry) + 0.120 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v264_guidance_rank_clarity_qf_basic
hypothesis: Quarterly/basic guidance rank clarity may keep the v241 guidance-clarity edge while changing timing away from annual CFO and shareholder-equity guidance actives.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.48, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_basic_qf_v4_nd_maxguidance)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_basic_qf_v4_nd_minguidance))), 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate)), 42), 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_qf_v4_nd_maxguidance)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_qf_v4_nd_minguidance))), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_total, 126), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v264_guidance_recommendation_neglect_safe
hypothesis: Planning visibility under analyst-coverage neglect may behave differently from ordinary EPS or recommendation alphas if recommendation VECTOR fields are converted safely and kept as a small sleeve.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_maxguidance)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_minguidance))), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_estimate)), 63), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(anl4_norec), 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(rank(vec_avg(anl4_detailrecv4_est)), 63), 126), industry) + 0.150 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v264_assets_credit_news_guidance_small
hypothesis: Asset and credit news sentiment may provide a non-legal, non-M&A event confirmation for broad guidance clarity, but must stay small because legal/credit news capacity is already crowded.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_assets, 90), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_credit, 90), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rp_nip_assets), 90), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rp_nip_credit), 90), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_maxguidance)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_minguidance))), 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v264_pv13_pureplay_guidance_clarity
hypothesis: Guidance clarity may be more reliable for product-focused pure-play firms; product-structure fields are used only as a lightweight condition rather than another peer-value parent.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(single_sector_pureplay_company_count / (primary_sector_focused_company_count + 1), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_revere_term_sector_total, 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_maxguidance)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_minguidance))), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_estimate)), 63), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_30_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
